_about: PARKED SKETCHES, tier 1 only: identity rows for fighters who are not in the build. Not loaded, not hashed, and not part of the recipes window. build_roster.py puts these beside the two rows of ../movegen/identity.json and runs the generator on all of them. `like` names a row of that file to start from; what a row here says replaces it key by key (inside `energy`, key by key too). `alt`: rows with the same word are options for one place in the roster (Orb picks one), and the share rule of the heavy cell never counts them against each other. `borrows`: the packs that are another fighter's; with no pack of his own, every pack is borrowed. `tier`: 1 until his mechanic exists. Nothing here is drawn for any of them: what is posed below is borrowed from the Protagonist and the Anti-hero, and what must be his alone comes out as waiting.
_legal: Legal screened these rows on 2026-10-12 (RL-133 to RL-135, docs/legal/roster-sketches-screen.md): pass, with one correction to the Protagonist's falling palm (one arm) and conditions that are in movegen-banned.json (b14, s09). No row holds a blow on a downed opponent: the grammar has none.
_borrowing: common: of a pack he borrows, a row reads only the lights and mediums that both fighters of the build have posed (37 today), so the pieces that are the Protagonist's alone or the Anti-hero's alone stay theirs. all: every piece of every pack (build_roster.py --borrowing all tries it and writes nothing). The heavy tier goes by the cell's share rule under either. docs/combat/roster-rows.md has both measured.
_order: where both fighters have a strike, each has his own copy of it, and a row reads the copy of the later pack: the Anti-hero's by default (fists, plates and blade hands). The Hopper lists his own order, to read the Protagonist's copies (open hands and kicks).
_packs: the common pool today: every strike pack that exists. A row reads them all unless it lists its own `waves`

cyborg_press._who: The Demon Cyborg as the Press (Art's silhouette 1): the grappler. Mass that arrives late and all at once. Forearm plates, hammer fists, the shoulder and crossed forearms, on drops and rams, to the chest and the arms.

weightsBy._why: he works on the body and the arms: what a clamp would hold

never.why: his hands are plates and hammers, never a blade hand
the broadest body in the roster does not spin

manner._about: How he throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.heavy: Mass that arrives late and all at once. The tell is slow and plain, the blow comes down or straight through with the whole body behind the plate, and he does not hurry back
manner.burst: Short shoves of plate and shoulder that end with something coming down
manner.reach: An open palm set flat on him, and the shot let go through it

cyborg_courier._who: The Demon Cyborg as the Courier (Art's silhouette 2): the fastest. In, a strike, gone. Elbows, knees and straight hands on short lines and rises.

never.why: he never turns his back: no spin
no kick above the chest: his speed is in short lines

manner._about: How he throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.heavy: Short and exact. He is in, the blow is thrown from where the limb already is, and he is gone: no more tell than the timing asks for, and nothing left out after it lands
manner.burst: A rattle of straight hands, elbows and knees that ends on a straight
manner.reach: An open palm set on him and let go at once, already leaving

cyborg_hopper._who: The Demon Cyborg as the Hopper (Art's silhouette 3): the devourer. He leaves the ground to hit. The legs do the work: a knee that carries him up, a heel that brings him down. The arms stay below the rim.

never.why: his arms stay below the rim of the funnel: nothing by hand or elbow comes down from above (Art's clearance rule)
the head sits inside the funnel: no headbutt
he leaps, and Legal's b03 refuses a leaping rise to the jaw or the head: his rises go to the gut and the chest

manner._about: How he throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.heavy: He leaves the ground to hit. A knee carries him up or a heel brings him down, the funnel tips with it, and he lands square. The arms never rise over the rim
manner.burst: Quick low hands that keep the rival still, and then the heel
manner.reach: An open palm low on the body, below the rim, and the shot let go along it

cyborg_hopper._legal: Legal's screen of 2026-10-12 (docs/legal/roster-sketches-screen.md): a leap is allowed for a knee or a foot to the gut, chest or legs and never by hand, elbow or head (b14); a sole or heel from above on a standing opponent is clear (s09), so the ban this row held for that ruling is gone. A downed opponent's head, face, neck and groin are out of the base moveset until the rating decision; the grammar has no blow on a downed opponent at all. His leap is a new drive (the hop), which is not built: his rising heavies are named as heaves until it is

empress._who: The Empress (the Galactic Tyrant; she/her since Orb's ruling of 2026-09-29), written on the Regent, Art's silhouette 1. She barely moves. One open hand held as a blade, and the heel of the foot: one clean line or one cut downward, from a body that stays upright.
empress._cloth: Art's three silhouettes put the mantle behind her (the Regent), all round her (the Bell) or in front of her (the Tabard). This row is right for the Regent. The Bell has her legs under cloth, so her kicks and knees would not be seen; the Tabard hangs a panel in front from the shoulder to the knee, which a knee or a front kick would cross. docs/combat/roster-rows.md says what each costs. The mantle itself is a new limb, at tier 2.

weightsBy._why: precise: the point of the jaw, the breastbone, the arm that reached for her

never.why: she never closes her hand: no fist and no hammer fist
she does not turn her back on anyone
she does not lean her weight on anyone

manner._about: How she throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.heavy: She barely moves. One hand, one clean line or one cut downward, from a body that stays upright; the blow ends exactly where it was aimed and she is still again. Nothing is shown before it but the hand rising to its place
manner.burst: Small exact cuts with one hand, the other arm still, and then one that comes down
manner.reach: A blade hand laid flat on him and the shot let go off its edge: a cut, not a burst. Never a pointed finger

guard._who: The Empress's guards (docs/design/empress-guards.md): troopers, not fighters, on the shared mannequin. Their kit is lights and mediums from the common pool, one heavy and a bolt; no signature, no forms, no grabs. A kit row: only the cells the kit names, only pieces more than one fighter has posed, no share rule, outside the gate (as the training dummy is)

kit._about: cells: the cells he has and how many places each; from: common, only what more than one fighter of the build has posed; newOf: a weight he may take a new shape of when nothing common is posed (no heavy of the tier is common: each fighter's ten are his own); quotas: a cell's quotas of his own (his one bolt is the measured bolt, one hand, thrust, planted); ownPacks: packs drawn for the guards alone (Animation's rival10, the falling sole), read though nobody else has them

weightsBy._why: a plain blow to the body

never.why: a trooper's blows are plain: no spin
no headbutt: the guards are a screen, not brawlers

manner._about: How he throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.light: Plain and drilled: straight hands and short knees, the same way every time, so the gang reads as one unit
manner.interjection: Thrown from the side of the pair while following the one, with a wind-up he can see for 10 ticks

energy._posed: Animation's sequence bm.guard_bolt (beam1, played through fighters.json roles.common.bolt): the measured bolt, one open palm thrown flat

reference._who: The reference fighter, in the roster as Orb's training dummy (docs/design/fighter-pipeline.md section 8): base stats and the common pool, frozen, exempt from the gate on a fighter's own blows. A kit row: every cell of the brawl, only pieces more than one fighter has posed, nothing new, no share rule. His lock keeps it as it is: he is the yardstick, and a change to him is a change to every reading

kit._about: No heavy of the tier is common (each fighter's ten are his own), so his B is the common pieces that stand in at B's wind-up, as both fighters' did before the tier was posed. No energy piece is common: his bolt and blast in reach go without a piece

manner._about: How he throws, in words, for Animation and Legal. Not read by the generator
manner.light: Plain and even: the common pieces as both fighters' packs have them, so a reading against him is a reading against the game, not a style

reach._about: Energy in reach for a row with nothing drawn: the key sets of the two fighters in the build, by name. A row's energy.reach names one of these. open_hands is the Protagonist's four bolts and two blasts (open palms). blade_hands is the Anti-hero's three blade-hand bolts with the Protagonist's palm thrust as the fourth, and the Protagonist's blasts: Legal's e06 allows an open hand, a blade hand or the Anti-hero's own lit fist, so no new fighter borrows the lit fist, and the pinch is refused in reach.
